description: This file defines the 'Module' class in the OpenMRS core platform, representing a module's metadata, configuration, dependencies, and extension points within the system.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents an OpenMRS module, encapsulating its metadata, dependencies, configuration, and extension points, and providing methods to load and manage module-specific resources.

methods.name: getModuleActivator
methods.description: Lazily loads and returns the ModuleActivator instance for this module, creating it via reflection if not already instantiated.

methods.name: setModuleActivator
methods.description: Sets the ModuleActivator instance for this module.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns the list of extensions, expanding extension names into full extension objects if needed.

methods.name: setExtensionNames
methods.description: Sets the map of extension point IDs to their class names, which can be expanded into full Extension objects.

methods.name: expandExtensionNames
methods.description: Creates Extension instances from extension class names using the module's class loader, populating the extensions list.
